method: Each original desktop-closed.png, desktop-open.png, mobile-closed.png and mobile-open.png under smoke/ID, and marketing/ID.webp was separately inspected through vision_analyze. No comparison boards used. Parent review-results.json read after image inspection.
scope: Static visual review only; no fresh motion, collision, source parity, custody or user approval verification. Apparent hinge gaps are visual concerns, not proven disconnected geometry. Framing and lighting differences preclude calibrated color or dimension equivalence.

entries.parent_status_justified: yes, as a bounded visual candidate pass with caveats, not final approval

observations.desktop-closed: Pale broad chest, three thick-rimmed bog pools and straight segmented path are readable and fully framed. Limestone is smooth and weakly stone-like; water is flat teal; dark green lid seam reads slightly ajar.
observations.desktop-open: Entire raised lid and empty lined cavity fit. Rim corner joins are conspicuous; rear lid/hinge relationship looks separated from this angle and needs contact evidence before mechanical-fidelity claims.
observations.mobile-closed: Pools and path remain readable. No clipping or UI overlap; fine detail and small secondary text are weak.
observations.mobile-open: Full silhouette and cavity fit; rim/hinge joins are jagged but no definite major missing faces.
observations.marketing: Same three-pool layout, path, pale chest and gold fittings. More mottled banks and surface shading, not a fundamentally different design.

caveats: Simplified water and molded-looking banks
Apparent hinge spacing is unresolved by stills
No automatic regeneration warranted

entries.parent_status_justified: yes as a conservative artistic hold; the supplied marketing image is itself faceted, so the parent's craggy-landscape contrast is stronger than this review can independently establish

observations.desktop-closed: Tower, snowy angular peaks, green ground and masonry chest clearly communicate theme. Complete silhouette; repeated pale blocks and broad mountain facets remain stylized.
observations.desktop-open: Pale hollow interior and raised slab lid fully framed. Small hinges and exposed lid clasp have ambiguous seating; no definite major intersection.
observations.mobile-closed: Tower and snow remain legible. No clipping or control overlap; mountain/vegetation detail reduces to simple facets.
observations.mobile-open: Complete lid, cavity and feet visible. Mild aliasing and uncertain hinge connection, not demonstrated breakage.
observations.marketing: Retains tower, masonry, brass, angular snow mountains and green terrain. More speckled surface treatment and irregular joints; still visibly a stylized miniature.

caveats: Preserve artistic decision hold
Do not describe marketing as unambiguously photoreal or entirely different geometry
No fresh hinge contact proof

entries.parent_status_justified: yes for landscape/material acceptance; both model and supplied marketing retain simplified canopy and panel-like waterfall, so differences should not be overstated

observations.desktop-closed: Kaieteur cascade, green canopy and sandstone escarpment readable. Waterfall looks like a ribbed white panel; mottled body is muddy and plants rounded. Full framing.
observations.desktop-open: Green lid underside and brown hollow cavity visible. Lid-to-hinge separation and discontinuous green corner trim are conspicuous visual concerns.
observations.mobile-closed: Landscape remains recognizable, but white strip waterfall and rounded shrubs read as a miniature toy rather than natural water/forest. No cropping.
observations.mobile-open: Complete object fits; uneven rim joins and loose-looking hinge attachment persist. No catastrophic rendering failure.
observations.marketing: Same green lid, tan cliff, lump-like canopy, white ribbed cascade and flat turquoise pool. Stronger surface treatment does not eliminate the shared water realism limitation.

caveats: Potentially important apparent hinge separation; static screenshots do not prove mechanical disconnect
Water and rainforest realism need an artistic decision
Preserve hold without art edits

entries.parent_status_justified: yes for motif and composition retention with finish and hardware caveats; not proof of convincing ceramic glaze

observations.desktop-closed: Turquoise body, ivory eight-point stars, blue/lavender lid and brass hardware retained. Full object fits; matte surfaces, abrupt motif cutoffs and dark lid seam reduce polish.
observations.desktop-open: Blue cavity and lid underside fully visible. Rear hinge pieces look separated across a dark gap; stepped rim corners are conspicuous.
observations.mobile-closed: Star pattern and palette recognizable with no clipped UI. Thin motif edges alias; headline has tight but intact right margin.
observations.mobile-open: Open cavity and complete lid fit. Small blue bottom projection can be a foot, not established stray geometry; pale corner caps and seams remain visible.
observations.marketing: Same stars, blue lid, turquoise walls and brass fittings. Surface reads textured or painted rather than unequivocally glazed ceramic; raised lid stars and richer texture are more apparent.

caveats: Material identity is not convincingly glazed in either representation
Hinge contact unresolved
Final approval hold remains

entries.parent_status_justified: yes for retained design with explicit felt and wood-finish limitations

observations.desktop-closed: Cream panels, pink/red paired scrolls, circular lid lattice, warm brown frame and brass retained. Felt is not fibrous; full silhouette fits.
observations.desktop-open: Brown hollow interior and lid show strong regular horizontal banding. Hinge seating looks loose across dark gaps; no definite absent walls.
observations.mobile-closed: Scrolls and central lid ornament remain legible; blocky edges and tiny secondary text. No cropping or overlap.
observations.mobile-open: Full lid, clasp projection, cavity and feet fit. Texture banding remains obvious; hinge relation mechanically ambiguous.
observations.marketing: Same cream inset panels, paired pink ornaments and wooden circular lattice. Cream finish resembles leather/paint more than clear felt; brown grain is richer and less uniform.

caveats: Do not claim tactile felt fidelity
Regular wood stripes and angular scrolls remain
Static images do not prove hinge attachment

entries.parent_status_justified: yes only as a limited visual candidate pass; apparent hinge separation in both open captures deserves an explicit unresolved note

observations.desktop-closed: Blue-gray chest, gold fittings, striped lid inset and pale mountain cluster retained. Fully framed; closed lid dark gap and subdued front details are conspicuous.
observations.desktop-open: Stone-blue cavity and lid fully framed. Lid/hinge assembly appears floating across rear gap; narrow rim strips have broken-looking corner joins.
observations.mobile-closed: Mountain cluster and striped inset remain readable. Fine front marks and dark feet lose contrast; no clipped object or controls.
observations.mobile-open: Entire open silhouette fits. Apparent lid separation and doubled/uneven rim edges persist at mobile scale.
observations.marketing: Same mottled blue body, pale faceted peaks, striped inset, brass and feet. More tactile surface appearance; mountain size difference cannot be inferred reliably across framing.

caveats: Highest-priority concern is apparent rear hinge/lid separation, not a confirmed mesh defect
Graphic stripes are not tactile woven fabric
Retain full source/physical-contact verification hold

entries.parent_status_justified: yes; independently visible crimson-versus-mauve and dark-top presentation divergence warrants the existing direction hold

observations.desktop-closed: Crimson chest with gold lattice, dark inset lid diamonds, brass fittings and rounded feet. Full framing. Gold lines have boundary breaks and uneven aliasing; body reads smooth coating rather than woven textile.
observations.desktop-open: Crimson lattice continues across lid underside and cavity. Full silhouette fits; dark rear hinge clearance and abrupt rim joins look unfinished.
observations.mobile-closed: Crimson/gold identity legible with no overlap or clipping. Thin lattice jagged; feet chunky and dark.
observations.mobile-open: Open state and cavity readable; front-left and rear-right rim corners show thin bright edges/protrusions. No definite major mesh failure.
observations.marketing: Body visibly mauve/pink with charcoal lid inset rather than model crimson treatment. Same lattice, diamond ornaments and hardware; irregular lines and soft feet remain.

caveats: Palette mismatch is an art-direction decision, not proven renderer malfunction
Weak weave/raised-thread material readability
Hinge and corner joins require closer technical evidence

global_findings: All original states inspected show fully contained objects and no definite severe clipping, missing major panels or broken mobile layout.
Repeated apparent hinge gaps and uneven rim joins merit explicit follow-up; no critical mechanical failure can be confirmed from these static angles.
Small mobile secondary text and aliasing recur; these are presentation caveats, not proven control failures.
No final user art approval, launch authorization or hold removal is supplied by this review.
